subject: Follow-up: infra & compliance clarifications — Hosted / Dedicated / Private fit
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Arun Patel <arun.patel@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: infra & compliance clarifications — Hosted / Dedicated / Private fit

Hi Arun — thanks again for the demo/discovery today. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can size Dedicated vs Private and pull the compliance artifacts your security team will expect.

1) Identity: you mentioned central SSO — can you confirm whether Okta SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated) is the requirement, or do you need SCIM provisioning as well? If you have an IdP team contact, please share.

2) Key management: you said you need customer-managed keys. Do you require an HSM-backed BYOK flow (FIPS 140-2/3) with on-prem key material, or would a cloud KMS with import and HSM protection be acceptable? Any specific vendor (e.g., Thales, AWS CloudHSM) preference?

3) Logging & retention: you called out regulatory retention of logs — is 7 years the firm requirement, and does that apply to raw audit logs (token-level traces) or summarized application logs? Also confirm whether logs must be exported to your SIEM (Splunk) vs retained in our logging storage.

4) Network topology: quick confirm — do you anticipate a Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment with direct connect/VPN and customer-managed networking, or would a Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) deployment with private peering suffice? Which one is preferred if both are possible?

Next steps from our side: we will bundle SOC 2 summary, an initial architecture sketch, and a short delta cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private. Can we schedule a 45-minute security deep-dive next week (options below)?

Availability: Tue 6/15 10–11am PT, Wed 6/16 2–3pm PT, Thu 6/17 9–11am PT.

Attaching a short recap. I’ll loop Rishi for the technical feasibility notes and Laura on commercial/commit considerations.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: recap.pdf (summary of discovery call)
From: Arun Patel <arun.patel@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: infra & compliance clarifications — Hosted / Dedicated / Private fit

Kimberly — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Answers below:

- Identity: Okta SAML 2.0 is required for SP-initiated flows. SCIM provisioning would be a plus but not mandatory at first; we’d likely do SCIM in phase 2. Primary contact is Maya Singh (cc’d).

- Keys: We require HSM-backed BYOK; our security policy expects keys to be generated in an HSM (FIPS 140-2 level) and for Redwood to support a hardware-backed import/export lifecycle or an external key reference. If Redwood offers a CloudHSM integration (AWS CloudHSM or Thales Luna) that is acceptable provided keys are under our control.

- Logs: 7 years retention is firm for audit logs. This includes both access/audit trails for model inputs/outputs (redacted for PHI where applicable) and system-level logs. Preferred export target is our Splunk instance via secure forwarder.

- Network: Because we will be handling PHI, our security team prefers Private VPC deployment (customer-controlled networking, direct connect). If Private isn’t possible quickly, we can evaluate Dedicated with strict peering and IP allow-listing as an interim step.

We’ll need SOC 2 Type II, encryption details, and a network diagram for the procurement packet. Also please include a cost delta (monthly) for Dedicated vs Private and any one-time onboarding costs.

Can do Tue 6/15 10am PT for the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Arun Patel
Director, Infrastructure & Security | Greenfield Health
arun.patel@greenfieldhealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Arun Patel <arun.patel@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: infra & compliance clarifications — Hosted / Dedicated / Private fit

On Fri, 11 Jun 2027 at 09:17 AM Arun Patel <arun.patel@greenfieldhealth.com> wrote:
> - Keys: We require HSM-backed BYOK; our security policy expects keys to be generated in an HSM (FIPS 140-2 level)...

Thanks for the clarity, Arun — this is helpful. Quick technical notes and constraints from engineering:

- HSM/BYOK: We support several BYOK flows. For Private deployments we can integrate with customer-controlled HSMs (bring-your-own-key) and support CloudHSM (AWS) or on-prem Thales via standard KMIP or vendor APIs. For Dedicated (hosted reserved capacity) we can offer a cloud-KMS import flow where keys are uploaded and wrapped with an HSM-backed service; if strict FIPS provenance (generated in customer HSM) is required, Private is the safest path.

- Log retention: We can export logs to your Splunk forwarder; for 7-year retention we recommend exporting to your archive storage (S3 Glacier or your on-prem archive) to control retention policies and e-discovery. Note: storing full model inputs for 7 years may raise PHI concerns — we should align on redaction and retention classes during the security call.

- Network/connectivity: Private VPC + Direct Connect gives the cleanest isolation model and supports your key import policies. Dedicated with private peering is feasible for initial rollout but requires us to lock down routing and fallback policies.

I attached an initial architecture sketch to show options (Private with HSM vs Dedicated with cloud-KMS). I’ll prepare a short tech delta and list of artifacts (SOC2 report, MSA redlines, compliance questionnaire answers) to send prior to the deep-dive.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: initial-arch-sketch.png

Kimberly / Rishi — adding commercial context.

- Commitment: if Greenfield can commit to a 12-month reserved Dedicated contract we can offer a different pricing profile and some onboarding credits. Private deployments have a higher one-time onboarding and setup fee (network, HSM integration, on-prem packaging) — we should surface a clear delta in the estimate.

- Ask to Procurement: please confirm expected procurement timeline and whether they will accept Redwood's standard MSA or need redlines. If they need redlines, please upload the markups and we’ll triage legal.

- Meeting: Confirming Tue 6/15 10:00am PT works for a 45-minute security/deployment deep-dive. I’ll join to cover commercial tradeoffs and potential credits.

Laura Bennett

   - Initial architecture sketch (initial-arch-sketch.png)

4) Procurement note: Laura — please flag any special terms they need but we should request procurement timeline prior to the call so legal can triage quickly.

I’ll upload the artifacts and send the calendar invite with a short pre-read. Looking forward to the call — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kimberly
